annotations.title: Estimate what IVF costs in the US

description: A US IVF cost estimate built only from cited line items (the base cycle, medications, anesthesia, embryo freezing, a frozen transfer, genetic testing and other add-ons), with a low, typical and high figure per cycle and for several cycles, and the source of each line.

cycles.description: How many egg retrieval cycles to plan for (default 1).

include.description: Optional line items to count beside the base cycle. Leave out for the usual set (medications, anesthesia, freezing and a frozen transfer).
